name: KCubing Fall 2017

venue.name: Connection Point Church
venue.details: The church has changed it's name, but it's the same venue as the other KCubings.

information:
**T-shirts**
For the first time, we will have T-shirts and cube logos avilable for this competition. See the [T-shirts and Cube Logos](www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KCubingFall2017/tabs/2121) page for more information, and to see the designs.

**lunch**
Pizza will be served for $2 a slice.


Thank you to [TheCubicle.us](thecubicle.us) for sponsoring this competition. Check them out next time you order a puzzle.

[Directions](https://www.google.com/maps/dir//10500+E+State+Rte+350,+Raytown,+MO+64138/@38.9849374,-94.4588741,17z/data=!4m13!1m4!3m3!1s0x87c0e161caee72d1:0x83aaab1c75d39d09!2s10500+E+State+Rte+350,+Raytown,+MO+64138!3b1!4m7!1m0!1m5!1m1!1s0x87c0e161caee72d1:0x83aaab1c75d39d09!2m2!1d-94.4566854!2d38.9849374) on google maps.
